newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor wins shareholder nod on Evander deal.
newsitem.headline: Gencor wins shareholder nod on Evander deal.

text.p: Gencor Ltd said on Wednesday that it had won shareholder approval for the merger of its four Evander gold mines.
"The special and ordinary resolutions relating to the merger of the four mining companies were approved by the requisite majority of shareholders," Gencor said in a statement.
The Business Day newspaper said that approval was won after a last-minute deal was struck with dissident shareholder Mercury Asset Management Group Ltd.

Mercury, which owns 26 percent of Winkelhaak Mines Ltd and 16 percent of Kinross Mines Ltd, voted for the restructuring but against the cancellation of Gencor's management contracts with the four mines which are to be amalgamated.
Gencor said that as a result of Mercury being against the cancellation, management contracts would not be cancelled but instead reviewed by independent directors.
The paper said Gencor had agreed to renegotiate the 128 million rand value it had placed on the cancellation of its management contracts with the mines.
The other two mines are Leslie Gold Mines Ltd and Bracken Mines Ltd.
The implementation of the merger is now requires Supreme Court sanctioning the schemes of arrangement.
